summary: Kernel-checked orientability and volume-form algebra layer: VolumeFormData on an oriented finite-dimensional real inner product space with the explicit determinant interface, the metric-scaling law vol(c . g) = c^(n/2) vol(g), the orientation-reversal sign law, and the finite-dimensional change of variables for linear maps with nonzero determinant (algebraic determinant rule and measure-theoretic Haar lintegral rule). The manifold-level Riemannian volume form and measure are explicit unproved Props with named blockers and the exact missing mathlib dependencies (manifold orientation, top alternating-form bundle, smooth frame field, manifold measure theory, partition-of-unity gluing, Haar measure on manifolds).

VolumeFormData.volume_form: VolumeFormData.volumeForm is definitionally mathlib Orientation.volumeForm (with the Fact instance installed locally from finrank_eq)

determinant_interface: VolumeFormData.volumeForm_eq_det: D.volumeForm = b.toBasis.det for a positively oriented orthonormal basis b
VolumeFormData.volumeForm_eq_neg_det_of_orientation_ne: D.volumeForm = -b.toBasis.det for a negatively oriented orthonormal basis

scaling_law.statement: VolumeFormData.volumeForm_smul_metric: D.scaledVolumeForm b c hc = c ^ (D.n / 2 : Real) . D.volumeForm
scaling_law.pointwise: VolumeFormData.scaledVolumeForm_apply: D.scaledVolumeForm b c hc v = c ^ (D.n / 2 : Real) * D.volumeForm v
scaling_law.determinant_computation: VolumeFormData.scaledBasis_det_apply: (D.scaledBasis b c hc).det v = c ^ (D.n / 2 : Real) * b.toBasis.det v, from Module.Basis.det_unitsSMul
scaling_law.orthonormality: VolumeFormData.scaledBasis_orthonormal: c * inner R (scaledBasis i) (scaledBasis j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
scaling_law.exponent_bridge: sqrt_pow_eq_rpow_half: Real.sqrt c ^ n = c ^ (n / 2 : Real) for c > 0

change_of_variables.algebraic: VolumeFormData.volumeForm_comp_linearMap: D.volumeForm (T . v) = LinearMap.det T * D.volumeForm v
change_of_variables.measure_lintegral: lintegral_comp_linearMap_eq: integral^- x, g (T x) dmu = ENNReal.ofReal |(LinearMap.det T)^-1| * integral^- y, g y dmu for LinearMap.det T != 0
change_of_variables.measure_lintegral_inverse: lintegral_linearMap_eq: integral^- y, g y dmu = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det T| * integral^- x, g (T x) dmu

facts.euclideanVolumeFormData_two_apply: vol v = v 0 0 * v 1 1 - v 0 1 * v 1 0 in dimension 2
facts.euclideanVolumeFormData_scaling_witness: c = 4 in dimension 2 gives scaledVolumeForm v = 4 * volumeForm v
facts.euclideanVolumeFormData_reverse_apply_ba: reverse volume form on the standard basis is -1
facts.euclideanVolumeFormData_changeOfVariable: vol ((2 . id) . v) = 4 * vol v (det (2 . id) = 4)

blocked.reason: manifold orientation and smooth top alternating-form bundle missing; only the pointwise Orientation.volumeForm exists
needs the TopFormBundle contract (FiberBundle/VectorBundle/ContMDiffVectorBundle for x |-> AlternatingMap R (TangentSpace I x) R (Fin n)) and a smooth positively oriented orthonormal frame
no MeasurableSpace/BorelSpace for charted spaces, no integration of top forms, no Riemannian density gluing by partition of unity

items: Manifold orientation: no tangent-bundle orientation, no orientability predicate, no orientation double cover (only Orientation R M iota for a module)
Top alternating-form bundle: no FiberBundle/VectorBundle/ContMDiffVectorBundle instances for x |-> AlternatingMap R (TangentSpace I x) R n
Smooth frame field: stdOrthonormalBasis/Orientation.finOrthonormalBasis are noncomputable and not smooth in the base point
Manifold measure theory: no MeasurableSpace/BorelSpace instance for a ChartedSpace, no integration of top-degree forms, no Riemannian volume density sqrt(det g)
Partition of unity: SmoothPartitionOfUnity exists but no gluing of local volume forms/densities into a global measure
Haar measure: IsAddHaarMeasure only for locally compact topological groups and finite-dimensional real vector spaces, not for manifolds

honest_boundary: The VolumeFormData layer is finite-dimensional linear algebra on a single inner product space; it does not construct a volume form on a manifold.

The metric-scaling law is proved for the metric represented by the explicit scaled form (x, y) |-> c * inner x y and the explicitly constructed (c . g)-orthonormal basis scaledBasis; no second InnerProductSpace instance is introduced on the same type.
The measure-theoretic change of variables is the linear Haar-measure statement, not a change-of-variables formula for smooth maps between manifolds.

The manifold orientation, the smooth top alternating-form bundle, the smooth global volume form and the Riemannian volume measure are not constructed; they are the blocked Props with the exact missing mathlib dependencies listed in this card.
No claim is made about Ricci flow, the Poincare conjecture, or manifold-level curvature.
The Euclidean witnesses are concrete consistency checks on EuclideanSpace R (Fin n), not claims about smooth manifolds.
